description: Lists the tenant's manual correction bookings. status is one of pending, approved, rejected or superseded; period (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) restricts the list to one month. Without filters all statuses are returned.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

status.description: Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected or superseded

name: list-manual-adjustments
